description: This Java class 'TestContextLoader' extends Spring's AbstractContextLoader to create and initialize a web application context suitable for testing purposes. It allows for multiple refreshes of the application context and is used in test configurations for the OpenMRS web module.

classes.name: TestContextLoader
classes.description: Custom context loader for Spring testing that creates a refreshable web application context using XML configuration locations.

methods.description: Constructor for the custom context loader.

methods.description: Loads a web application context based on XML configuration locations provided as arguments.

methods.description: Returns the suffix used for resource files, '-context.xml'.
